public_rationale: Contemporary and retrospective reporting supplies revenue rates for OpenAI and Anthropic, but not a comparable industry total. Microsoft's disclosed AI revenue and Epoch's discussion of reseller revenue are material challenges to the claimed majority. Their different dates and coverage prevent a decisive comparison. The claim remains unresolved because the denominator is missing, not because annualized revenue has been rejected in favor of an unstated quarterly-sales measure.
limitations: The post does not define the industry boundary or treatment of transactions between suppliers.

No supported share calculation can be made from these mismatched inputs.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: By the author's estimate, OpenAI and Anthropic account for more than half of all generative AI industry revenue, hyperscalers included.

statement.excerpt: Nevertheless, OpenAI and Anthropic's revenues amount to, by my estimates, more than half of the entire revenue of the generative AI industry, including the hyperscalers.
statement.document_title: The Hater's Guide To The AI Bubble

from_speaker: the entire revenue of the generative AI industry
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is an estimate of the companies' contemporary share of generative-AI revenue at the time of the post.

Use the latest reported monthly revenue rates available around June and July 2025, through the post date. The surrounding discussion uses annualized figures, so the claim is not restricted to realized April–June sales.
Annualized rates must be compared with annualized rates; annual totals and full-year forecasts cannot be substituted.
The numerator combines OpenAI and Anthropic. The denominator includes other generative-AI suppliers and hyperscaler generative-AI services.
The author's estimate is a qualification of the measurement, not a conditional antecedent.
A consistent treatment of reseller revenue and payments between suppliers is necessary. The speaker does not specify that treatment.
criteria.support_condition: A comparable contemporary revenue estimate, including hyperscalers, places OpenAI and Anthropic together above 50% of the total.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A comparable contemporary estimate places their combined share at or below 50%, or a defensible same-basis lower bound for the rest of the industry equals or exceeds their combined revenue.

Epoch's analysis highlights the importance of hyperscaler and reseller revenue, which weighs against assuming model developers dominate the whole industry. Its earlier timing and different coverage prevent it from settling the July majority-share claim.
